header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Private respondents in C.P No. D-976/ 2026 in person.
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w Inspector Javed of P.S
None present for the petitioners; nor intimation received.
body: Learned Additional A.G submits that F.I.R in respect of murder of Mst. Saima @ Baby Mari was registered at P.S Khan and after conclusion of trial, said case has been disposed of. In view of such a situation, instant petitions have become infructuous and are, accordingly, disposed of.
